verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an official MCP server. A user adds it to their AI assistant, logs in through OAuth, and the assistant then acts as that user within their role permissions, so the workspace can be operated through natural-language requests. Fieldwork separately lets users describe a control in plain language and have AI agents collect and package the evidence. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (this route depends on an external assistant), documentation of which operations the MCP tools expose, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
